global_rules: Correctness gates run before performance for every revision, workload, numeric policy, and candidate.
Measured runs use clean immutable snapshots; a dirty working tree is never benchmark input.
Benchmark and profiler ownership is serialized through todo-orchestrator and the CUDA resource controller.
A benchmark lease, profiler lease, GPU lease, and declared host-pressure allowance must all exist before the corresponding command starts.
Free device memory must be sampled immediately before acquisition and remain above the tier headroom floor after declared peak allocation.
V100 sm_70 is the current native baseline; Ampere, Hopper, and Blackwell results use distinct device-performance classes and never silently replace it.
Deep profiling is limited to one selected candidate-workload pair per source revision unless an explicit diagnostic exception is recorded.
This contract creates no lease, reservation, watch, or benchmark run by itself.

tiers.purpose: Fast schema, fixture, build, scalar-parity, and launch-contract validation.
tiers.resource_class: gpu:any only after an implementation target exists

tiers.purpose: Decision-quality end-to-end measurements on pinned structural traces.
Sustained reuse and amortization evidence after a representative winner exists.
Falsification and fallback selection under hostile structure, order, reuse, and sequence regimes.
Explain one already-correct representative or adversarial result; never select a winner alone.

reject_when: another benchmark or profiler lease overlaps
unowned process materially consumes the selected GPU
host load exceeds the declared tier budget
clock, thermal, ECC, or power state changes invalidate comparability
median absolute deviation or another predeclared variance bound is exceeded

snapshot_contract.dirty_tree_policy: refuse measured execution and build a clean temporary snapshot instead
